dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature on the posterior margin, describing a smooth spline from the dorsal ridge to the rounded apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded classification with a wide pixel radius at the maximum morphological height.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree positive slope relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the torso.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.2:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex curve with a large radius extending from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Relatively short and robust projection with a high thickness-to-length ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the transition point from the melon slope to the dorsal surface of the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced specular highlights in high-intensity cyan/white visible along the dorsal-lateral ridge, indicative of light refraction or caustics.
